title: Work on building two new cement plants starts in Tajikistan
content: Tajikistan: Construction work on two new 1.2Mt/yr cement plants has begun on behalf of Tajik Cement and Dushanbe Cement. The new plants are both located in Varzob District, close to the country’s capital of Dushanbe, according to Interfax. Both plants are expected to be completed by the end of 2027.
